reproducibility_probe_source:
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

scratch = Path('.superpowers/sdd/2026-11-10-o3d-export-fidelity/task-2-scratch')
base = ['blender', '--background', '--factory-startup', '--python-exit-code', '1', '--python',
        'tests/smoke_export_fidelity.py', '--']
commands = [base + ['--case', 'custom_normal', '--compare-reference', '.gitignorefolder/Blender-OMSI-Exporter'],
            base + ['--compare-reference', '.gitignorefolder/Blender-OMSI-Exporter']]
records = []
for command in commands:
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
    records.append({'command': command, 'exit_code': result.returncode,
                    'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr})
    (scratch / 'reproduce-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2) + '\n')
    assert result.returncode == 1, records[-1]
    print('DEFAULT_OUTPUT_COMMAND_EXIT', result.returncode, command)
summary = json.loads((scratch / 'baseline/summary.json').read_text())
assert len(summary['cases']) == 29
counts = {'current': 0, 'reference': 0, 'textures': 0, 'retained_reference_errors': 0}
for case in summary['cases']:
    relative = case['manifest']
    focused = json.loads((scratch / 'focused-baseline' / case['group'] / relative).read_text())
    repeated = json.loads((scratch / 'baseline' / relative).read_text())
    no_reference = json.loads((scratch / 'all-no-reference' / relative).read_text())
    assert 'setup_error' not in repeated, repeated
    assert focused['status'] == repeated['status'] == no_reference['status'], case
    for label in ('current', 'reference'):
        a = focused['exporters'].get(label, {})
        b = repeated['exporters'].get(label, {})
        if 'sha256' in a:
            assert a['sha256'] == b['sha256'], (case, label)
            counts[label] += 1
            if label == 'current':
                assert a['sha256'] == no_reference['exporters'][label]['sha256'], case
        elif 'error' in a:
            assert a['error'] == b['error'], case
            counts['retained_reference_errors'] += 1
    if 'texture' in focused:
        assert focused['texture']['sha256'] == repeated['texture']['sha256'] == no_reference['texture']['sha256'], case
        counts['textures'] += 1
reproduction = {'cases': 29, 'matching_records': counts,
                'compared': ['separate focused groups with reference', 'all groups with reference', 'all groups without reference']}
(scratch / 'reproducibility.json').write_text(json.dumps(reproduction, indent=2) + '\n')
print('REPRODUCIBLE_BASELINES_OK', reproduction)
